title: Marex enters football financing market
summary: Marex partners with Pinto Capital to expand football club financing options, offering Premier League and EFL Championship clubs flexible funding solutions.
body_markdown:
*Partnership with specialist sports advisory firm Pinto Capital will give Premier League and EFL Championship clubs access to additional financing options*


Marex Group Limited (‘Marex’ or the ‘Group’, NASDAQ: MRX), the diversified global financial services platform is entering the football financing market through a partnership with Pinto Capital, a specialist sports investment and advisory firm.


The partnership follows Marex’s appointment as Principal Partner of Nottingham Forest FC earlier this season and marks a further expansion of its financial services offering into this sector. The collaboration combines Pinto Capital’s knowledge of club financing requirements and established relationships in football with Marex’s strong balance sheet, financial markets expertise and existing capabilities in financing, foreign exchange, payments and credit.


Paolo Tonucci, Chief Strategist and CEO of Capital Markets at Marex, said:


> “Football clubs are increasingly sophisticated businesses with significant and growing financing requirements, yet their access to capital can be limited. We see an opportunity to provide football clubs with a unique suite of services that meet these requirements – from financing, credit and risk management, to FX, payments and structured solutions. Through our partnership with Pinto Capital, we have an opportunity to give clubs more flexibility in managing their financial commitments and investing in future growth.”


The move comes as football’s commercial reach continues to expand, with 2026 FIFA World Cup attracting a record 6.8 million spectators. Meanwhile, external financing is a necessity. The Independent Football Regulator’s inaugural State of the Game report, published in October 2026, found that Championship clubs needed, on average, 57p in external financing for every £1 of revenue.


Marex will offer Premier League and EFL Championship clubs access to a broad range of flexible financing solutions. Potential structures include funding secured against future broadcasting revenues, sponsorship income, transfer-fee receivables, matchday revenues and season-ticket sales. These solutions are designed to help clubs manage the timing of cash flows, meet financial commitments and fund investment, while giving owners and club operators additional choice beyond traditional banking relationships and specialist lenders.


Greater financing flexibility has potential benefits across the football ecosystem: helping clubs, owners and operators plan investment more effectively and supporting the longer-term development of facilities and experiences for supporters.


Laurie Pinto, Founder of Pinto Capital, added:


> “Outside the largest clubs, funding options have traditionally been concentrated among club owners, banks and a relatively small number of specialist lenders. By partnering with Marex, we are creating opportunities to give clubs and their owners access to additional capital and a broader range of financial services, addressing the considerable demand we are seeing for more flexible financing.”


Marex announced a multi-year Principal Partnership with Nottingham Forest FC in August 2026. As part of the agreement, Marex is the club’s front-of-shirt sponsor, with its branding featuring on the men’s and women’s playing shirts, the Forest netball team’s dresses, at prominent sites at the City Ground on matchdays and across digital platforms.


**About Pinto Capital**


Pinto Capital LLP is a boutique sports M&A advisory firm specialising in the acquisition, sale and financing of professional sports assets. Since 2015 Pinto Capital has executed deals across the English football pyramid including the Premier League, EFL and National League and in a range of professional sports such as basketball and cricket. Pinto Capital holds deep sector expertise in the sports finance ecosystem and works across a range of stakeholders to shape the next generation of ownership, craft and execute transactions and offer creative financing solutions for rights holders, clubs, fans and owners alike.


**About Marex**
Marex Group Limited (NASDAQ:[MRX](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/marex-invests-in-digital-prime-technologies-inc-302843362.html#financial-modal) ) provides market access, infrastructure services and essential liquidity to clients across global commodity and financial markets. The Group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four services: Clearing, Agency and Execution, Market Making and Hedging and Investment Solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to more than 60 exchanges. Marex has over 3,400 active clients, including some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 50 offices worldwide, the Group has over 3000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.
